Dashboard portfolios

Source: R/data.R
portfolios.Rd

The publisher pages of the dashboard, one row per page and agreement. A portfolio is the set of transformative agreements of one publisher, so agreement_id gives the ESAC IDs of a page. Its journals are those of its agreements in agreement_journals.

Usage

portfolios

Format

A tibble with 3 columns:

  • portfolio_id (string, key): Page slug, e.g. wiley

  • portfolio_label (string): Page title, e.g. Wiley

  • agreement_id (string, key): ESAC ID of an agreement on this page (→ agreements). The page's journals are those of its agreements in agreement_journals

See also

Other reference tables: agreement_institutions, agreement_journals, agreements, journal_issns, journals
